title: Finite local freeness under the Zariski-etale quasi-coherent equivalence
statement: Let $T$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], and let $F$ be a quasi-coherent module on $(T_{\mathrm{et}},\mathcal O_T)$ [def-trf-space-quasi-coherent-module, def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Let $F_{\mathrm{Zar}}$ be its restriction to open subschemes, the inverse under [lem-trf-scheme-zariski-etale-quasi-coherent-equivalence]. Suppose that there is a jointly surjective etale scheme family $e_a:T_a\to T$ [def-weil-etale-morphism] such that each tensor pullback $e_a^*F$ [def-trf-space-etale-module-functors] is locally a finite direct sum of copies of $\mathcal O_{T_a}$ on its small etale site. Then $F_{\mathrm{Zar}}$ is finite locally free on the Zariski topology: every point has an open neighbourhood $U$ with $F_{\mathrm{Zar}}|_U\cong\mathcal O_U^{\oplus n}$ for some finite $n$, allowed to depend on $U$. Conversely a Zariski finite locally free module has an etale finite locally free associated module. No constant-rank or Noetherian hypothesis is required.

source.place: Tag 05VG (lemma-equivalence-quasi-coherent-properties), finite locally free clause, and Tag 05B2 (lemma-finite-locally-free-descends); the equivalence is Tag 03DX (proposition-equivalence-quasi-coherent), part (2).

proof.text: Put $G=F_{\mathrm{Zar}}$ and write $L_U$ for extension from Zariski to small-etale modules on a scheme $U$. By [lem-trf-scheme-zariski-etale-quasi-coherent-equivalence], $G$ is quasi-coherent, $L_TG\simeq F$, and $(e_a^*G)_{\mathrm{et}}\simeq e_a^*F$. Here $e_a^*G$ is quasi-coherent by [lem-weil-pbc-module-pullback-quasi-coherent], so the extension is defined on the stated quasi-coherent subcategory. Thus $L_{T_a}(e_a^*G)$ has the local finite free frames assumed for $e_a^*F$.

source.place: Tag 05VG (lemma-equivalence-quasi-coherent-properties), proof of the finite locally free case, using Tag 03DX (proposition-equivalence-quasi-coherent), part (2), and Tag 05B2 (lemma-finite-locally-free-descends).

proof.text: Choose a covering $\{g_{ab}:V_{ab}\to T_a\}_b$ on which those frames are defined. The restriction comparison of [lem-trf-etale-extension-free-presentations-hom] identifies the framed restriction with $L_{V_{ab}}(g_{ab}^*e_a^*G)$. Restrict its isomorphism with $\mathcal O_{V_{ab},\mathrm{et}}^{\oplus n_{ab}}$ to Zariski opens. The same node says that restriction of $L_{V_{ab}}H$ recovers $H$, with identity unit on open sections. Restriction of a finite direct sum of structure modules is the corresponding finite direct sum of Zariski structure modules: on an open $W$ both are $\Gamma(W,\mathcal O_W)^{n_{ab}}$, and the restriction maps agree coordinatewise. Hence $g_{ab}^*e_a^*G\simeq\mathcal O_{V_{ab}}^{\oplus n_{ab}}$. Quasi-coherence for this application follows again from [lem-weil-pbc-module-pullback-quasi-coherent]. With $f_{ab}=e_a\circ g_{ab}$, the composition comparison in [def-pc-module-pullback] gives $f_{ab}^*G\simeq\mathcal O_{V_{ab}}^{\oplus n_{ab}}$.

source.place: Tag 05VG (lemma-equivalence-quasi-coherent-properties), proof of the finite locally free case, using Tag 03DX (proposition-equivalence-quasi-coherent), part (2), and Tag 05B2 (lemma-finite-locally-free-descends).

proof.text: Each $g_{ab}$ is etale, and its family is jointly surjective, by [def-weil-pbc-etale-site]. The composites $f_{ab}$ are etale by [lem-weil-pbc-etale-composition-cancellation]. They are jointly surjective: lift a point of $T$ first to some $T_a$ and then to some $V_{ab}$. Consequently they form a covering of the final object of $T_{\mathrm{et}}$. By [lem-weil-pbc-fpqc-finer-than-etale], this family is an fpqc covering of $T$.

source.place: Tag 05VG (lemma-equivalence-quasi-coherent-properties), proof of the finite locally free case, using Tag 03DX (proposition-equivalence-quasi-coherent), part (2), and Tag 05B2 (lemma-finite-locally-free-descends).

proof.text: Apply clause (2) of [lem-pc-fpqc-descent] to the quasi-coherent ordinary module $G$ and the fpqc covering $\{f_{ab}\}$. Every $f_{ab}^*G$ is finite free by Step 2, hence finite locally free. Reflection of finite local freeness gives that $G$ is finite locally free, meaning it is $\mathcal O_U^{\oplus n}$ on a Zariski neighbourhood of each point. We use finite local freeness itself, without prescribing a common rank $r$ in the additional fixed-rank version of that clause; the integers $n_{ab}$ may vary. This is precisely the unrestricted-rank descent assertion of Tag 05B2.

source.place: Tag 05VG (lemma-equivalence-quasi-coherent-properties), proof of the finite locally free case, using Tag 03DX (proposition-equivalence-quasi-coherent), part (2), and Tag 05B2 (lemma-finite-locally-free-descends).

proof.text: Conversely, let $G$ be Zariski finite locally free and choose open frames $G|_{U_c}\simeq\mathcal O_{U_c}^{\oplus n_c}$. Each $\mathcal O_{U_c}^{\oplus n_c}$ is $\widetilde{A^{n_c}}$ on every affine open $\operatorname{Spec}A\subseteq U_c$, so $G$ is quasi-coherent [pqf-def-coherent] and the clauses below for quasi-coherent modules apply. Open immersions are etale by [lem-weil-pbc-etale-composition-cancellation], so the inclusions $u_c:U_c\to T$ form an etale covering as well. By [lem-trf-etale-extension-free-presentations-hom], $(L_TG)|_{(U_c)_{\mathrm{et}}}\simeq L_{U_c}(u_c^*G)$; by [lem-weil-pbc-open-immersion-module-pullback-restriction], $u_c^*G\simeq G|_{U_c}$, hence $\simeq\mathcal O_{U_c}^{\oplus n_c}$. The same node says that $L_{U_c}$ preserves finite coproducts and sends the structure module to the etale structure module. It therefore sends each displayed frame to $(L_TG)|_{(U_c)_{\mathrm{et}}}\simeq\mathcal O_{U_c,\mathrm{et}}^{\oplus n_c}$. This proves the converse. If $T$ is empty the local conclusions are vacuous; if a frame has rank zero the same argument uses the empty finite direct sum. No bound on ranks, Noetherianity, or quasi-compactness of $T$ has been used.
